describe: The image shows a roof of curved clay roof tiles laid in overlapping rows. About 8 tile columns run across the width and about 12 rows run down, each tile a rounded S-shaped curve with a dark shadowed lower edge. Colours are brick red, rust orange and dark brown-blue, with grey weathering and some darker stains. Lighting is even with moderate contrast. The pattern is regular, so the tile rows and courses must stay aligned.
